# FOLO
> FOLO Only Looks Once: a from-scratch Rust vision framework. It has its own tensors, autograd, CPU kernels and
> wgpu/WGSL GPU kernels, a YOLO-style detector (folo-n/s/m/l/x), and training, evaluation and export. It ships one
> `folo` CLI (every command supports `--json`, with stable exit codes), an HTTP + SSE API (`folo serve`), an MCP
> server for agents (`folo mcp`), the FOLO Studio web app, the FOLO Desktop native app, and in-browser inference
> (wasm + WebGPU). Status: v0.1, early. COCO-pretrained weights are published and download over HTTPS (`folo weights
> pull folo-s-coco`, folo-s, val2017 AP 0.416; `folo weights pull folo-n-coco-v5`, folo-n, AP 0.370). Binaries for
> Windows and Linux are in the GitHub release (README, Install); anywhere else, build from source.

Fastest path for an agent:
- **MCP:** `folo mcp` (stdio; `--data-dir DIR`, default `~/.folo`). It has 45 tools: folo_info, list_datasets, get_dataset,
  list_dataset_issues, list_dataset_images, register_dataset, create_synthetic_dataset, audit_dataset,
  merge_datasets, filter_dataset, dataset_export, list_models, train,
  run_status, list_runs, stop_run, reorder_run, val, predict, predict_batch, export, compare_runs,
  cloud_connections, cloud_offers, cloud_instances, cloud_terminate, and for labeling with a Claude Code, Codex or
  Antigravity agent list_label_jobs, create_label_job, start_labeling, stop_labeling, label_status, list_label_images,
  view_label_image (the image with its boxes drawn and numbered, boxes in pixels of that view),
  set_label_boxes, review_label_images and export_label_dataset, and for vision benchmarks bench_catalog,
  list_benchmarks, get_benchmark (with the leaderboard), create_benchmark, delete_benchmark, start_bench_entry (a
  model, or a file of predictions made elsewhere), bench_entry (progress, or the five-axis score; wait follows it),
  stop_bench_entry and compare_bench_entries (head-to-head score, axis, accuracy, speed, and condition deltas).
- **CLI:** `folo <command> --json`. stdout is then JSON Lines only. Errors end with
  `{"error":{"code","message","hint"}}`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 not found, 4 not implemented or
  not supported on this machine.
- **Discovery:** `folo describe --json` prints every command, argument and default, plus every MCP tool's input and
  output schemas.
- **From a checkout:** `cargo folo ...` (an alias for `cargo run --release -p folo-cli -- ...`).

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what FOLO is and the end-to-end workflow, the speed and accuracy charts against Ultralytics
  yolo26n, quickstart, Studio and Desktop, agent setup (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / .mcp.json), architecture at a glance,
  where each folder is, and project status
- [Docs index](docs/README.md): every doc in docs/, grouped by task (use FOLO, drive it from an agent, the apps, the
  internals, measuring, contributing), and a reading order for a new contributor
- [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md): the longer walkthrough. It covers building, synthetic data, training on your
  own YOLO or COCO folder, dataset checks, fine-tuning from a .folo file, resume, val, predict, export, Studio,
  in-browser inference and troubleshooting
- [Agent cookbook](docs/AGENT_COOKBOOK.md): recipes in two forms, MCP tool calls and `folo ... --json`. They cover
  training on a folder, comparing runs, finding label problems, export and inference, scripting with --json, and
  sharing runs with Studio
- [MCP server](docs/MCP.md): the `folo mcp` contract. Flags are `[--data-dir D] [--device auto|cpu|gpu:N] [--mock]
  [--read-only] [--confine] [--server URL]`; it speaks MCP 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25. It documents the tools with
  their JSON Schemas, the `folo://` resources (dataset images, subscribable runs and metrics, sample grids, docs),
  the prompts train_on_folder, label_folder and diagnose_run, and the errors: `isError` results whose text is
  `{code, message, hint}`
- [CLI](docs/CLI.md): every `folo` command (serve, describe, doctor, train, stop, val, predict, export, quantize,
  bench, dataset synth|stats|check|convert|split|merge|filter, weights, cloud, label, mcp), its flags and its --json records, plus the
  error and exit-code conventions

## Reference
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md): the HTTP + SSE contract of `folo serve`, used by Studio, Desktop and `folo mcp --server`.
  It covers datasets, models (weights download), runs (live events), predict, val, export, agent labeling
  (`/api/label`), vision benchmarks (`/api/bench`), uploads, cloud compute (`/api/cloud`), and real vs mock mode
- [Agent labeling](docs/LABELING.md): unlabeled images to a dataset. `folo serve` drives Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity
  (one model request per batch of images, no tools), a person reviews the boxes in Studio (or an agent does, with
  the MCP label tools or `folo label`), and the result is a registered YOLO dataset. It has the workflow, the HTTP
  calls, what a run costs in tokens and measured accuracy
- [Vision benchmarks](docs/BENCH.md): grade any vision model on your own images. A benchmark is a frozen set of
  labeled images plus a plan of stress conditions (twelve, at severities 1 to 5); an entry is a FOLO model, a
  coding agent or externally made predictions, scored 0 to 100 on five axes (accuracy, robustness, self-labeling,
  calibration, localization), each defined exactly; a self-improvement loop has a model label a pool, trains a
  student on those labels alone and grades it. HTTP API under `/api/bench` (feature `vision_bench`); the engine is
  `crates/folo-bench`; `folo bench` drives them from the command line (docs/CLI.md, Vision benchmarks), the MCP benchmark tools
  from an agent (docs/MCP.md, Benchmarks). Not the
  speed benchmark (docs/BENCHMARKS.md, `cargo bench`)
- [Cloud compute](docs/CLOUD.md): training runs on a rented GPU (RunPod) or on another FOLO server
  (`TrainConfig.compute`, `folo cloud`, MCP `cloud_*`). It has the lifecycle of a cloud run, how instances are
  never left behind, the providers, and `folo serve --token`
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the map of the repository. It covers the crates (folo-core, folo-gpu,
  folo-nn, folo-data, folo-vision, folo-api, folo-bench, folo-client, folo-cloud, folo-server, folo-mcp, folo-cli,
  folo-wasm, folo-test-support), how they fit together, the main flows, and a "Where do I change ...?" table from a
  change to the files it touches
- [Server internals](docs/SERVER.md): how folo-server is built: the router, the Store and the services behind the API
- [Detector spec](docs/MODEL.md): the normative spec of folo-n/s/m/l/x. It covers the blocks, the head, the loss
  (CIoU/R-PIoU/NWD-IoU, BCE/MAL, DFL/OT-DFL), the task-aligned assigner, the training recipe (MuSGD with Polar-FOLO /
  Conv-GeoMuon, dense/BCKD/GT-verified distillation), and the inference path (SEBF/DFL-CGR post-processing, int8 CPU)
- [Vision internals](docs/VISION.md): a tour of folo-vision's code: `FoloModel` and `FoloV2Model` (FOLO v2-Iso), loss,
  assigner, fusion/NMS (SEBF, ELC/DFL-CGR), trainer, predictor, int8 quantisation and ONNX export
- [Core](docs/CORE.md): folo-core in depth: tensors, CPU kernels (BLIS GEMM, Winograd F(2×2) and F(4×4, 3×3), AVX-VNNI
  int8 and direct u8 stem) and autograd
- [Data](docs/DATA.md): YOLO and COCO detection rules, label parsing, robustness, augmentation, the bit-exact AVX2
  warp/resize/HSV L1-fused planar data loader, dataset checks and conversion
- [Metrics](docs/METRICS.md): how mAP, precision, recall and the confusion matrix are computed (pycocotools parity)
- [NN](docs/NN.md): modules, init, optimizers (SGD, AdamW, MuSGD with Polar-FOLO and Conv-GeoMuon), LR schedules, EMA,
  and `.folo` IO
- [File format](docs/FORMAT.md): `.folo` weights and checkpoints (safetensors-compatible) and its metadata
- [GPU](docs/GPU.md): the wgpu backend, buffer pool and WGSL kernels, adapter selection (`FOLO_GPU_ADAPTER`,
  `FOLO_GPU_BACKEND`) and testing
- [In the browser](docs/WASM.md): folo-wasm. It covers the build (`scripts/build-wasm.sh`), the JS API
  (`FoloDetector.load` / `detect`, the /api/predict result shape), WebGPU vs wasm-CPU performance and the browser
  test
- [Benchmarks](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): folo-n/s vs Ultralytics yolo26n/s/m on an RTX 4080 SUPER (GPU forward, end to
  end, CPU, training step, memory) and accuracy (COCO, fine-tuning), with the method, raw numbers and next
  optimisations. Scripts and raw JSON are in `bench/baselines/`; fine-tuning accuracy on small datasets (folo-n vs
  yolo26n and folo-s vs yolo26s, one pycocotools scorer) in `bench/finetune/`; the charts' data and generator in
  `tools/charts/`

## Code map
- [Crates](crates/README.md): the 14 crates of the root workspace in dependency order, what each uses, the dependency
  rules and where to start reading the engine
- Each crate's README maps its modules to what they hold: [folo-core](crates/folo-core/README.md),
  [folo-api](crates/folo-api/README.md), [folo-data](crates/folo-data/README.md),
  [folo-gpu](crates/folo-gpu/README.md), [folo-nn](crates/folo-nn/README.md),
  [folo-vision](crates/folo-vision/README.md), [folo-bench](crates/folo-bench/README.md),
  [folo-wasm](crates/folo-wasm/README.md), [folo-client](crates/folo-client/README.md),
  [folo-cloud](crates/folo-cloud/README.md), [folo-server](crates/folo-server/README.md),
  [folo-mcp](crates/folo-mcp/README.md), [folo-cli](crates/folo-cli/README.md),
  [folo-test-support](crates/folo-test-support/README.md)
- [Examples folder](examples/README.md): the shapes and COCO runs and `bench_external.py`, an external benchmark entry
- [Bench harnesses](bench/README.md): the Python scripts outside cargo (Ultralytics baselines, fine-tuning accuracy
  and the other folders under `bench/`)
- [Tools](tools/README.md): CI and development helpers, including `file-size.sh`, `test-tmp.sh` and the chart
  generator in `tools/charts/`
- [Scripts](scripts/README.md): `build-wasm.sh` / `build-wasm.ps1` and the install scripts

## Examples
- [Shapes](examples/shapes/README.md): the convergence test (folo-n on synthetic shapes at 320 px). It has the
  commands and per-epoch results on CPU (72 min) and GPU (169 s)
- [COCO](examples/coco/README.md): folo-n and folo-s pretrained from scratch on COCO 2017 at 640 px (val2017
  `folo-n-coco-v5` AP 0.370 / AP50 0.525 — 0.373 with DFL fusion, 0.3776 with SEBF + DFL-CGR — and `folo-s-coco` AP
  0.416 / AP50 0.580), with pycocotools parity and `folo weights`

## Apps
- [FOLO Studio](web/README.md): the web app (TypeScript + Vite on fw, its own UI framework in web/framework). It
  covers the dev server, checks, tests, screenshots (`npm run shoot`) and data sources
- [fw](web/framework/README.md): Studio's UI framework (JSX compiled at build time to DOM templates, fine-grained
  signals, no virtual DOM)
- [FOLO Desktop](apps/desktop/README.md): the native app. It covers running it, connecting to `folo serve`,
  `--mock`, `--scenario`, layout and screenshots
- [folo-ui](apps/desktop/ui/README.md): Desktop's UI framework (GPUI's API, CPU-rendered). It covers building and
  testing it, platforms, developer switches and the design record (`DESIGN.md`)
- [Design system](design/README.md): the shared design tokens (`design/tokens.json`) both apps generate their
  themes from
- Design direction and review logs, for UI work only:
  - Studio: [direction](web/DESIGN_DIRECTION.md), [rubric](web/notes/REVIEW_RUBRIC.md), [log](web/notes/HILLCLIMB.md)
  - Desktop: [direction](apps/desktop/DIRECTION.md), [rubric](apps/desktop/notes/REVIEW_RUBRIC.md),
    [log](apps/desktop/notes/HILLCLIMB.md), [review brief](apps/desktop/tools/review-brief.md)

## Project
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the entry point for Claude Code; points at AGENTS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md,
  docs/notes/PROCESS.md, and the crate READMEs
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): where to find your way, the four-role agentic subagent roster (orchestrator, implementer,
  play-tester/reviewer, writer), ground rules for contributors, the pull request workflow, and the repo layout
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): a map of the repository, building, the checks a pull request must pass,
  conventions, licence;
  [Security](SECURITY.md): reporting a vulnerability, and what to keep in mind when exposing `folo serve`
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): milestones, with what is merged, in progress and next
- [Releasing](docs/RELEASE.md): versioning, the tag → draft release workflow, the install scripts
  (`scripts/install.sh`, `scripts/install.ps1`) and the embedded Studio
- [CI](docs/CI.md): the CI jobs and their runners
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what the release contains
- [Docs site](site/README.md): the static site generated from these docs (`cd site && npm run build`), with search,
  link checking, and this file plus llms-full.txt (every page's Markdown in one file)
- [Engineering notes](docs/notes/README.md): not needed to use FOLO. The maintainers' agent process
  ([PROCESS](docs/notes/PROCESS.md)), the optimisation notebooks behind docs/BENCHMARKS.md (`docs/notes/hill/`), and
  three reports from agents that used FOLO as a newcomer would ([1](docs/notes/DOGFOOD-1.md),
  [2](docs/notes/DOGFOOD-2.md), [3](docs/notes/DOGFOOD-3.md))
